rules.description: Hardcoded API key or secret detected
rules.message: Hard-coded credentials should be replaced with environment variables or a secrets manager.
Use parameterized queries instead of f-string interpolation in SQL statements.

rules.description: Use of eval or exec without sanitization
rules.message: Avoid eval/exec with untrusted input. Consider safer alternatives.
Sanitize user-supplied path components to prevent path traversal.
Pickle can execute arbitrary code. Use safe serialization formats like JSON.
Avoid shell=True to prevent shell injection. Use argument lists instead.
Add type annotations to function signatures for better maintainability.
Consider refactoring this function into smaller units.
